# anthropic_claude_tag_bundle (Data Source)

Experimental. Fetches one Claude Tag (Claude in Slack) Bundle (`/v1/organizations/claude_tag/bundles/{bundle_id}`). Bundles are created and edited in claude.ai. The API is read-only for them. What a Bundle grants (connectors, repositories, credentials) is never returned.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "anthropic_claude_tag_bundle" "example" {
  id = "capp_00000000"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Bundle identifier (`capp_...`).

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp when the Bundle was created.
- `description` (String) What the Bundle is for. Null when it has none.
- `display_name` (String) Bundle name.
- `updated_at` (String) RFC 3339 timestamp of the last change to the Bundle.
